detailed_description: Text Template is a browser-side placeholder replacement helper for simple text templates. Edit the template textarea using placeholders such as {{ name }}, fill in the automatically detected variable fields, and click Process to generate the rendered text. The result appears below the form and can be copied. The tool is intended for quick plain-text substitution and does not import JSON files, download output files, support complex data types, or run a full template language with loops and conditionals.
usage_steps: Edit the template text and include placeholders using double braces, such as {{ name }}.
Fill in the detected variable value fields below the template.
Click Process to replace placeholders with the entered values.
Review the generated result and copy it when needed.
usage_examples: Example 1: Fill a short greeting template with a name, company, and role.
Example 2: Create a reusable plain-text message and change a few detected values before copying it.
Example 3: Test how placeholder names are detected from a copied template.
Example 4: Generate a simple note or snippet from manually entered values.
